local_convention.authority: S03 original rehearsal contract, not national date-counting law
local_convention.calendar: Add 6 or 9 calendar months directly to the original cutoff; clamp unavailable day to target month end. Do not add 180 days, working days, or chain two clamped additions.
local_convention.boundary: Equality to a review date requires manual date-boundary review; no automatic legal conclusion about last-day validity or holidays.
local_convention.extension_evidence: Only a verified project-legal entry with nonempty record ID and a stated until date may populate the local assumed-extension branch. Pending/sales assertions do not suffice. A date beyond the national maximum is rejected even if marked verified.
local_convention.overall_release: Always false; these checks do not authorize a securities issue.
